request:
镜头 s08：纪录片细节特写镜头，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：observational documentary footage from a research institute's own 2050s film archive, shot on Super 16 colour negative: lively visible grain, slightly soft resolution, cold fluorescent light mixed with one warm desk lamp, muted desaturated palette, deep shadows, imperfect handheld framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary insert close-up grabbed handheld, focus breathing
导演意图（自然语言）：微距特写，手持，焦点轻微呼吸。台灯下，一双手把一块回收的电路板装进一只凹痕累累的旧饼干铁盒里，这是一台自制的网络节点；拧上天线，盒子上的小灯第一次亮了。环境声：螺丝刀的咔哒声、机房嗡鸣。
情绪：focused, intimate, hopeful
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：macro close-up, handheld with focus breathing, one slow push in
景深与虚实：Very shallow depth of field: the solder point and LED crisp, the bench clutter melting into blur.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Insert close-up on the cluttered lab bench under a desk lamp: Song's hands fit a small green circuit board into an old dented biscuit tin that serves as the case of a homemade network router, with a short Wi-Fi style antenna on top; a fine-tipped soldering iron rests beside it and the router's first tiny status light glows. Blocking lock: the dented tin box sits at frame centre on the bench, Song's hands enter from frame left, the desk lamp glows at the top right.
Picture 2: Song's prototype node (the dented tin box, still without a sticker) (prop reference; role: prop reference). A handmade prototype network node: an old dented steel tin box with a plain scratched olive-grey lid, a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny LEDs and a short screw-on antenna, on a cluttered lab workbench under a desk lamp. No sticker on the lid.
Picture 3: Engineer Song (Song Qi, 33 in 2048, systems engineer on the 550 quantum-computer project) (character reference; role: the protagonist). A 33-year-old Chinese man, systems engineer on a national quantum-computer project. Slim, medium height, short neat black hair with a side parting, clean-shaven, a small mole under his right eye, warm attentive eyes with faint laugh lines, thin round steel-rimmed glasses. Light-grey knitted cardigan over a pale blue collared work shirt, a blank white ID card on a dark lanyard, a cheap black digital wristwatch on his left wrist.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：small screwdriver clicks, a faint electronic tick, low lab hum
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 7.0s, 24fps, observational documentary footage from a research institute's own 2050s film archive, shot on Super 16 colour negative: lively visible grain, slightly soft resolution, cold fluorescent light mixed with one warm desk lamp, muted desaturated palette, deep shadows, imperfect handheld framing; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, macro close-up, handheld camera with focus breathing, one slow push in from macro close-up on the whole tin to a tighter macro close-up on the circuit board and the status light; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: the dented tin box at frame centre on the bench, Song's hands entering from frame left, the desk lamp glowing at the top right, the equipment rack dark in the background and the bench clutter blurred at the frame edges. Start: Song's fingers lower the small green circuit board into the open tin, tipping it slightly to clear the rim, the thumb steadying the board's edge. Middle: the board settles onto its improvised mounts; his right hand leaves frame and returns with the short antenna, screws it down against the tin's back corner with two small turns, and the tin rocks a millimetre on the bench with the pressure; the focus breathes in and out across his knuckles, the solder points sharpening and softening. End: he releases the antenna, the tin settles level, and the first tiny status light on the front edge comes on, a small steady glow; his hands come to rest on either side of the box without covering it. Mood: focused, intimate, hopeful. Blur: the solder point and the lit LED stay crisp, the soldering iron, the wire coils and the jar of screws melting into soft shapes, the background rack dissolving to dark grey. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Low continuous lab hum, the faint whine of cooling fans in the rack, small screwdriver clicks and the dry scrape of metal threads, the soft clack of the circuit board seating into the tin, the tin rocking on the bench top, a brief breath through the nose close to the microphone, one faint electronic tick as the light comes on; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
